fields.description: What the material IS at this point. Leave it empty and name a step instead to add a phase inside the stage above.

How long this stage takes, off the protocol's own timings: tray plus pot for a motherstock, sticking to planting for a propagation stage. A stage with steps under it is the sum of them. Change the weeks on the protocol, not here.
fields.label: Weeks

fields.description: Material lost at this stage. Worked out from the protocol's own loss fields -- the TC order allowance, the cutting reject rate, rooting and field establishment. Change it on the protocol.
fields.label: Loss %

fields.description: Ticked on the first stage that comes from outside the farm -- TC, Seeds, Tubers, Budwoods, Bought-in Plants. What the stage is decides this; there is nothing to choose.
fields.label: Bought at this stage

fields.description: Order to arrival, when bought at this stage.
fields.label: Supplier Lead (weeks)
Share Of The Order
fields.description: What share of this variety's material is bought in this form. A crop bought one way leaves it blank and takes the lot. Eryngium is bought as tissue culture AND as roots in the same year, from different suppliers, with different lead times -- so each entry stage carries its share and the two order dates fall out of it.
Unused. Costing reads its prices from the TC price bands and the purchase documents, not from here.
fields.label: Rate per unit

fields.description: Units out per unit in. Worked out from the protocol's multiplication settings -- a motherstock at four cycles yields four mother plants per plantlet. Change it on the protocol, not here, so one number cannot become two.
fields.label: Yields per unit
Stands and is cut from
fields.description: Material here is established once and cut from week after week -- a motherstock. It is not consumed by one planting, so it is bought once and sized from the busiest week, not from the season's total.

fields.label: Yields per unit per week
fields.description: What one standing unit hands on each week -- cuttings off one mother plant. Derived from the protocol's Cuttings Per Plant Per Week.
How many times material may go round at this stage -- motherstock generations, tuber divisions. 0 means it does not recycle.
fields.label: Max Cycles

fields.description: The item material is held as at this stage. What lets stock already on hand -- roots in store, motherstock standing, tubers in the cold room -- be counted against what a plan needs instead of being bought again.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Material handed back when the crop is lifted -- tubers off a dahlia clump, roots off an eryngium. Nets off next season's requirement.
fields.label: Returns per plant at lift
